_README: This file is the whole community page. Nothing on /community is written into the HTML.
join_url  — the WhatsApp community invite (https://chat.whatsapp.com/...). While it is
empty the page falls back to a direct WhatsApp chat, so every button still
works; paste the group link here and it upgrades everywhere at once.
sessions  — add one object per session. The page sorts them, works out which month to
show, drops the ones that have passed into 'What we've covered', and derives
the weekday label from the date so the two can never disagree.
kind      — the small label above the title, e.g. 'Live Session'

sessions.title: Your Degree vs AI: Who Has the Advantage?
sessions.blurb: See how degrees, practical skills and AI literacy compare in today's job market, and what to build next.

sessions.title: AI for Work: Now and in 2027
sessions.blurb: A hands-on masterclass on using AI tools to get everyday work done faster and be more ready for the workplace.

sessions.title: Can You Really Make Money With AI?
sessions.blurb: A realistic look at AI income options, skills, freelancing and business use, so you can tell what works from hype.
